features.title: Narration and previews
features.description: Read your exact wording with ElevenLabs or optional local Kokoro. Search voices and select a stable voice ID.

features.title: Voices and delivery
features.description: Save narration presets. Set supported model controls, native speed, pronunciation dictionary references and explicit pauses.

features.title: Progress and cancellation
features.description: Check jobs and stop local work. The assistant connection must stay open during generation.

features.title: Save generated audio
features.description: Export completed narration as WAV without generating or paying again. Existing files are never overwritten.

requirements: Python 3.9 or later is required for the connector; it is not bundled.
ElevenLabs needs the API key saved in Just Aloud and provider credits.
Local Kokoro needs the optional Just Aloud runtime on Apple Silicon.

clients.name: Codex
clients.status: Setup command provided; current client attachment is not detectable by the app.

clients.name: Other local MCP clients
clients.status: Manual stdio configuration; individual integrations have not been tested.

examples: Find a warm British voice, preview this paragraph, and save the WAV to Downloads.
Save my selected voice and delivery as Document narrator, then use it for this text.
Check my narration job and export its completed audio without generating it again.
limitations: Closing the assistant connection cancels active narration; completed audio and request keys remain on this Mac.
Cancellation cannot refund cloud work already accepted. Reuse the same request key after an uncertain error.
No HTTP server or remote connection. Client setup is separate from installing the connector.
Voice quality and pronunciation require listening review.
privacy: ElevenLabs receives supplied text and voice settings. Kokoro synthesis stays on this Mac after its optional downloads. Credentials remain in Keychain; generated audio and job records are stored privately on this Mac.
cost: Cloud narration uses ElevenLabs credits. Discovery does not synthesize speech. Replaying and exporting saved results make no new synthesis request.
